Agentic AI Landscape

From Chatbots to Autonomous Workflows

  • The global agentic AI market reached $10.86 billion in 2026.
  • Fortune Business Insights projects 40% of enterprise apps will feature task-specific AI agents by 2026.

Only fewer than < 24% of pilot programs successfully transitioned to operational status, highlighting a critical trust gap.

02: Reasoning, On-Device & Hardware

Deep reasoning models shifting from pattern matching to logical deduction
On-device AI enabling privacy-preserving local inference on edge devices

REASONING MODELS

The Era of Deep Thinking

  • DeepSeek R1 costs 95% less than peers while matching OpenAI o1 on math/coding.
  • Models like o1/o3 use Chain-of-Thought steps to reduce hallucinations in complex domains.
  • Recent evaluations show LLMs fall short of automated theorem provers in rigorous Rust verification.
  • Adopt hybrid architectures: reserve deep reasoning for high-stakes, low-volume tasks requiring accuracy.
Strategic Insight: Reasoning is shifting from pattern matching to logical deduction. Cost parity with top-tier models democratizes access, but fragility in formal logic demands human oversight.

INFRASTRUCTURE

On-Device AI vs. Cloud Inference

Metric On-Device (Edge) Cloud (Centralized)
Performance Snapdragon X2: 5x faster than Intel Core Ultra 9 NVIDIA B200 / Cerebras WSE-3
Efficiency 60% faster inference, 45% less power High energy consumption per query
Model Scale Up to 13B parameters locally Trillions of parameters (unlimited scale)
Privacy Data never leaves the device Data transmitted to remote servers
Best Use Case Healthcare, Finance, Personal Assistants Complex Reasoning, Training, RAG

STRATEGIC ANALYSIS

Vertical AI vs. General Purpose Models

General Purpose

  • Provides broad applicability across diverse tasks
  • Delivers high cost-efficiency for standard operations
  • Scales effortlessly across multiple business functions

Vertical AI

  • Fine-tuned on industry-specific data for higher accuracy
  • Ensures regulatory compliance in healthcare and finance
  • Demonstrates superior relevance in complex legal matters

Hybrid Approach
